objective: Proof and computation. In every knot space (a connected cubic triple system on which the signed knot fails), removing a line ties its three points: they carry one value up to signs, so the leftover is a hub, the point side of a 3-edge cut. Splicing a knot space at a line into another at a point gives a knot space, for a sign choice on the three new incidences; every 3-edge cut of a knot space is such a splice of its two contractions; and with THREEFOLD-GRAMMAR every knot space is glued this way from Fano atoms and planar glue, plus 4-sums for non-planar glue.
status: Proved by HUB-GLUE-20261102-001A-P001: in every knot space removing a line ties its three points (the two all-equal patterns), so selection leaves the point side of a 3-edge cut; splicing a knot space at a line into another at a point gives a knot space for exactly one switching class of new signs (1216 splices); both contractions of every simple 3-edge cut are knot spaces (10 of 10); with THREEFOLD-GRAMMAR every knot space is assembled by such splices from Fano atoms and planar glue, plus 4-sums
title: Selection leaves a hub, and selected spaces glue into knot spaces
